text: Appeal of Order to Comply (February 15, 2022) for 3379 Lawrence Avenue East, Elevator.

The Property Standards Committee, Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply (February 15, 2022) for 3379 Lawrence Avenue East, Folder No. 22 112786 PRS 00 IV, and, in doing so, granted an extension of time to September 30, 2022, and that the appellant provide a letter of intent to the Municipal Licensing and Standards Division that said repair will be completed by the specified date of September 30, 2022.
